title: Rabbi Yose ben Chanamel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yalkut Nechemyah, section 1071, mentions him saying, “By Torah law they became obligated,” etc. Hyman says the name is a textual error: the parallel at the beginning of Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit, chapter 6, has Rabbi Yose bar Chanina. The Yalkut labels its source Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot; Hyman corrects this to Sheviit.

notes.text: תתרעא has numerical value 1071, not 871 as the older note says. Hyman proposes Yose bar Chanina and Sheviit in place of the Yalkut’s Yose ben Chanamel and Shevuot.
